need: An FBI agent investigates a series of murders by a serial killer in a crime film or thriller.

query_params.text: An FBI agent investigates a series of murders by a serial killer in a crime film or thriller.

results.title: Fallen
results.overview: Homicide detective John Hobbes witnesses the execution of serial killer Edgar Reese. Soon after the execution the killings start again, and they are very similar to Reese's style.

results.title: Frailty
results.overview: A mysterious man arrives at the offices of an FBI agent and recounts his childhood: how his religious fanatic father received visions telling him to kill people who were in fact "demons."
